description: Use this when the user asks where an app's downloads came from (search, browse, websites, other apps) or about impressions, page views and conversion. Apple's App Analytics for each app, from App Store Connect's analytics reports, organic and paid alike: App Store impressions and page views, first-time downloads and redownloads, the conversion rate, purchases with proceeds in USD, subscription events (trial and paid offer starts, conversions to paid, paid starts, renewals, voluntary and involuntary churn, refunds) and active subscriptions (trials, paid offers, paid plans, billing issues), per app by day, by where people found the app (App Store search, which includes Apple Ads, App Store browse, App referrer, Web referrer) or by country. Days are UTC; the last two or three are incomplete. Apple makes these reports only after an Admin asks once, which Apptiller asks nobody to do, so only apps whose reports someone started (for another tool) have them. Says nothing about which campaign brought a download.

app.description: An Apptiller app (name or id from apps) or an App Store Apple ID. All apps when left out.

by.description: day: one row per app and day; source: per source type over the range; country: per territory over the range.

country.description: Only this territory, as Apple names it in the reports (e.g. US).
